description: Each version's planner request against an oracle: openpilot's unchanged radard + planner fed a hindsight reference lead (identity from the in-path ACC target, else the camera; range from the ACC target, else the raw object list within 1 m lateral, plus the camera when on the same car; Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoothing), through an interface that publishes only that lead. Owner 2.1 road drives and a second car's two drives, open loop.

definitions.unnecessary: request below the oracle's by > 0.5 m/s2 for >= 0.3 s
definitions.missed: oracle <= -1 m/s2 while the version > -0.5 for >= 0.3 s
definitions.confident: reference from the radar (ACC target or object list), radar and camera agree; camera-only moments are judged with video, not scored

turning_lead_case: video and optical looming: the in-lane lead slowed to turn off (about -3 m/s at 105-115 m) then left the lane; 2.1 braked -1.54 m/s2 for a car a lane over whose radar speed read a false -7 m/s; 2.3 -0.29; vision -0.08
